notFound.body: There is nothing at this address.

denied.title: Your role does not allow this page
denied.body: This page needs the {required} role. You are signed in as {name} with the {role} role. Ask an administrator if you need access.
denied.bodyUnknown: This page needs a higher role than yours. Ask an administrator if you need access.

signin.title: Sign in to git-migrator
signin.subtitle: Use your organization account to continue.
signin.testNotice: Test sign-in is enabled for this environment. It is not available in production.
signin.invalidCredentials: The email or password is not correct.

error.title: Sign-in was not completed
error.role_assignment_required: You are not assigned an app role for git-migrator. Ask a tenant administrator to assign you one of the git-migrator app roles in Microsoft Entra ID, then sign in again.
error.tenant_not_allowed: This account belongs to a different Microsoft Entra ID tenant than the one git-migrator is configured for. Sign in with an account from the configured tenant.
error.actor_disabled: Your account has been disabled in git-migrator. Contact an administrator.
error.actor_not_found: No git-migrator account exists for this user. Contact an administrator.
error.sign_in_method_not_allowed: This sign-in method is not available.
error.sign_in_failed: Sign-in could not be completed because of a problem on our side. Try again, or contact an administrator if it keeps happening.
error.account_not_linked: This sign-in could not be matched to a git-migrator account. Contact an administrator.
error.unknown: Sign-in failed. Try again, or contact an administrator if it keeps happening.

problem.unauthenticated: Your session has ended or is not valid. Sign in again.
problem.forbidden: Your role does not allow this action. Ask an administrator if you need access.
problem.origin_not_allowed: This request did not come from the application. Reload the page and try again.
problem.not_found: The item you asked for does not exist.
problem.conflict: This change conflicts with the current state. Reload and try again.
problem.validation_failed: Some of the values you entered are not valid.
problem.too_many_streams: Too many live update connections are open. Close other tabs or try again shortly.
problem.busy: Another change to the same Route is in progress. Try again in a few seconds.
problem.not_ready: The service is starting or temporarily unavailable. Try again shortly.
problem.internal_error: Something went wrong on our side. Try again, or contact an administrator if it keeps happening.
problem.bad_request: The request could not be understood. Reload the page and try again.
problem.unsupported_media_type: The request was sent in a format the service does not accept.
problem.last_admin: This change would leave the system without an enabled administrator. Make another account an administrator first.

mapping.noRoutes: There are no Routes yet. Mappings appear once a Route is configured and its endpoints have been inventoried.

filter.searchPlaceholder: Search by name, login or email

exclude.title: Exclude from the migration
exclude.body: {name} will not be migrated and will not count against parity. A reason is required.

csv.title: Import identity mappings
csv.help: Upload a CSV file or paste its text. Check it first: every row is validated and nothing is changed until you apply a file without errors.
csv.tooLarge: The file is larger than 1 MiB.
csv.rejected: The file was rejected and nothing was changed. Check it again to see why.
csv.checkedOk: {count, plural, one {# row is valid.} other {# rows are valid.}} Nothing has been changed yet.
csv.checkedErrors: {count, plural, one {# problem found.} other {# problems found.}} Fix the file and check it again.
csv.applied: Applied: {mapped} mapped, {invited} invited, {excluded} excluded, {unchanged} unchanged, {replaced} replacing an earlier decision.

error.header_invalid: The first line must be exactly: source,target,action.
error.too_many_rows: The file has more than 5,000 rows.
error.unterminated_quote: A quoted value is never closed.
error.column_count: The row must have exactly three columns.
error.action_invalid: The action must be map, invite or exclude.
error.target_not_email: An invitation needs an email address as its target.
error.cell_too_long: A value is longer than 320 characters.
error.source_ambiguous: Several source identities match. Use the account id.
error.duplicate_source: This source appears more than once.
error.target_taken: This target is already mapped to another source.
error.email_conflict: The source already has a different email from its provider.
error.already_decided: This identity is already confirmed or excluded. Unmap it first.

rename.title: Edit the planned team slug
rename.body: Lowercase letters, digits and single hyphens. If a team with this slug exists, it is suggested.
rename.invalid: Use lowercase letters, digits and single hyphens, at most 100 characters.
